title: Polygonum hydropiper L. ethanol extract attenuates ferroptosis and ulcerative colitis by modulating glutathione metabolism through inhibition of KEAP1-Nrf2 interaction.
authors: Chen, Dazhi; Liu, Jian; Yan, Huanjuan; Yuan, Qili; Zhan, Huang; Ai, Yangwen; Wang, Xiaodong; Chen, Yongping; Shi, Lingyan; Zhang, Ya
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究水蓼提取物通过抑制KEAP1-Nrf2互作调节谷胱甘肽代谢减轻溃疡性结肠炎，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白互作和虚拟对接，但核心是KEAP1-Nrf2蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且方法以湿实验为主，仅少量对接，与TF-DNA结合建模课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: While ferroptosis inhibition in intestinal epithelial cells emerges as a novel therapeutic strategy for colitis, the scientific validation of Polygonum hydropiper L. - a traditional anti-inflammatory herb - remains unexplored, particularly regarding ferroptosis modulation. PURPOSE: This study aimed to systematically evaluate the therapeutic effects of ethanol-extracted Polygonum hydropiper L.(PHE) on colitis and elucidate its underlying molecular mechanisms, with particular focus on ferroptosis regulation. METHODS: The ethanol extract of PHE was pharmacologically evaluated in a dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced murine colitis model. RNA-Seq analysis of colon tissues and UPLC-LTQ-Orbitrap-MS phytochemical profiling were integrated with functional validation using erastin-induced ferroptosis in Caco-2 cells. Virtual docking, molecular interactions, and gene-editing were employed for mechanistic investigation. RESULTS: PHE administration significantly attenuated DSS-induced weight loss and disease activity index elevation, while preserving intestinal mucosal integrity. Transcriptomic analysis and in vivo experiments revealed PHE's regulation of glutathione metabolic pathways and ferroptosis. The flavonoids in PHE, especially aromadendrin, were identified as the primary active component binding to Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1(KEAP1)'s Kelch domain, thereby activating Nrf2 signaling and upregulating glutathione (GSH) synthesis genes. Nrf2 ablation or KEAP1 over-expression abolished PHE's protective effects, confirming pathway specificity. CONCLUSION: Our findings establish that PHE exerts anti-colitis effects through KEAP1/Nrf2/GSH axis-mediated ferroptosis inhibition, with aromadendrin serving as the key bioactive compound. This mechanistic elucidation provides translational rationale for developing PHE-based therapies for ulcerative colitis.
abstract_zh: 背景：虽然抑制肠上皮细胞铁死亡（ferroptosis）正成为结肠炎的新型治疗策略，但传统抗炎草药水蓼（Polygonum hydropiper L.）的科学验证仍未被探索，尤其是在铁死亡调控方面。目的：本研究旨在系统评估乙醇提取的水蓼（PHE）对结肠炎的治疗效果，并阐明其潜在分子机制，特别关注铁死亡调控。方法：在葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）诱导的小鼠结肠炎模型中，对PHE的乙醇提取物进行了药理学评估。将结肠组织的RNA-Seq分析和UPLC-LTQ-Orbitrap-MS植物化学分析，与erastin诱导的Caco-2细胞铁死亡功能验证相结合。采用虚拟对接、分子相互作用和基因编辑进行机制研究。结果：PHE给药显著减轻了DSS诱导的体重下降和疾病活动指数升高，同时保持肠黏膜完整性。转录组分析和体内实验揭示了PHE对谷胱甘肽代谢通路和铁死亡的调控。PHE中的黄酮类化合物，尤其是花旗松素（aromadendrin），被鉴定为与Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（KEAP1）的Kelch结构域结合的主要活性成分，从而激活Nrf2信号并上调谷胱甘肽（GSH）合成基因。Nrf2敲除或KEAP1过表达消除了PHE的保护作用，确认了通路特异性。结论：我们的研究结果表明，PHE通过KEAP1/Nrf2/GSH轴介导的铁死亡抑制发挥抗结肠炎作用，其中花旗松素是关键生物活性化合物。这一机制阐明为开发基于PHE的溃疡性结肠炎治疗提供了转化依据。
